name: Ansible Automation Strategic Alignment
description: This practice focuses on the business justification, strategic roadmapping, and governance modeling required to ensure that the adoption of Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform aligns with organizational objectives and yields measurable value.

alphas.name: Automation Strategy
alphas.description: Represents the strategic intent and planned roadmap for transitioning from fragmented scripts to a unified Ansible platform.

states.name: Vision Defined
states.description: The high-level objectives for Ansible adoption are documented.

checklist.name: Business Drivers Identified
checklist.description: Specific business problems (e.g., manual patching, slow deployments) are identified for automation.

checklist.name: Sponsorship Confirmed
checklist.description: An executive champion is identified who aligns with the automation-first culture.

states.name: Roadmap Validated
states.description: A phased roadmap for migration and growth is established and accepted.

checklist.name: Target Environment Mapped
checklist.description: Current infrastructure and automation gaps are fully documented.

checklist.name: ROI Projections Accepted
checklist.description: The financial benefits and TCO of moving to AAP are quantified and approved.

alphas.name: Automation Governance Model
alphas.description: Defines the policies, guardrails, and decision-making structures for managing automation content and execution.

states.name: Guardrails Defined
states.description: Standards for architecture, security, and developer experience are established.

checklist.name: Standard Operating Model Established
checklist.description: An opinionated model for operating Ansible in the environment is defined.

checklist.name: Compliance Requirements Integrated
checklist.description: Regulatory and security standards (e.g., RBAC, audit logs) are mapped to AAP features.

activities.name: Conduct Automation Gap Analysis
activities.description: Analyze the current automation estate to identify technology gaps, missing integrations, and tooling required for a holistic strategy.
activities.completionCriteria: A comprehensive report recapping current environment vs. future goals.

activities.name: Execute Architecture Standards Workshop
activities.description: Collaborative sessions to define high-level design, integration points, and governance guardrails for Ansible.
activities.completionCriteria: Documented architecture standards and governance model.

workProducts.name: Automation Strategic Roadmap
workProducts.description: A temporal plan showing the sequence of automation use-cases and platform maturity milestones.

levelOfDetails.name: Defined
levelOfDetails.description: Specific project timelines and resource allocations.

workProducts.name: Capability Gap Report
workProducts.description: Assessment of current skills, tools, and processes compared to the requirements of the new automation platform.

levelOfDetails.name: Logical
levelOfDetails.description: Identification of specific gaps in skills and technology.

workBreakdowns.name: Strategic Alignment Phase
workBreakdowns.description: Activities associated with defining the business and governance foundation.

workItems.name: Establish Business Objectives
workItems.description: Facilitate stakeholder interviews to align automation with top business priorities.
